request.style: English, soul, male baritone solo with gospel choir, piano, upright bass, drums, saxophone, organ, reverent and majestic, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
From the sons of Joseph came a line
Ephraim stood with heart and mind
Ammihud named, his father was
Elishama led the chosen class

[Chorus]
Elishama son of Ammihud
Leader of the tribe that stood
On the west side under flag
Guiding Israel through the track

[Verse]
When the camp was set in order
Standard raised to find the border
Elishama led the people through
With the census count to view

[Chorus]
Elishama son of Ammihud
Leader of the tribe that stood
On the west side under flag
Guiding Israel through the track

[Bridge]
Seventh day his offering came
Silver plate and basin frame
Fine flour mixed with oil so sweet
Gold dish filled, the altar kept

[Outro]
Nun his son, then Joshua came
Lineage recorded, never the same
